skill.summary: EU AI Act automation: risk classification, Article 11 documentation, bias testing, conformity assessment.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Adds comprehensive compliance automation features for EU AI Act, effective August 2, 2026.
- Supports risk classification by Annex III, Article 11 technical documentation generation, and bias testing integration in CI/CD.
- Enables conformity assessment package preparation for high-risk AI systems.
- Includes tools for regulatory monitoring across EU member states and gap analysis with remediation planning.
- Generates GPAI provider obligation documentation and audit-ready versioned records.
